scope: R1 static textured surfaces only. Character and other-room lighting remain unverified.
rendering_rule: Nearest authored texture colours, neutral tint, unshaded; preserve alpha and canonical decoded pixel data.
basis: Source XAF textured materials include zero colour; export fallback 0.4 is not an original light value. Controlled native-original comparison improves materially using original texture colours without fallback tint/ambient attenuation. This is not a claim that all original lighting states are reproduced.
